items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Now, her brother was John Glasgow, who was a singer.

ctx.x: Nannie Mae. Like nanny goat. Nannie Mae. Now, her brother was John Glasgow, who was a singer. He didn't play any instrument. And they had a brother, Dude -- we never quite found anything -- any talent in him. He was more or less the comedian in that family.

We had -- they had -- let me see, there was four girls and four boys in that family. And Leela played, and Helen is the only one of that family that's living now. Dodgie and the young daughter, that was named Bunch, but we called -- her show business name was Ivy. Well, now, Dodgie --
